1.explanation: Both the base WebGL renderer (WebGLLayerRenderer in Layer.js) and the WebGL tile renderer (WebGLTileLayerRenderer in TileLayer.js) never check the layer’s visibility flag when preparing and rendering frames. The layerStatesArray passed to prepareFrame contains a `visible` boolean (set to false when the group is hidden), but none of the WebGL rendering methods skip rendering for visible === false. As a result, WebGLTile layers remain drawn even when their group’s visibility is turned off.
1.bug_scenario: The demo opens a map with a single ol/layer/Group containing one ol/layer/WebGLTile. After 3 seconds the group’s visible property is set to false, but the WebGLTile layer stays rendered on the canvas. In contrast, if the layer type is changed to a normal Tile layer, hiding the group correctly hides the layer. The issue only affects WebGLTile layers.
